topic: Light Interaction and Simple Electric Circuits
key_concepts: Absorption is the ability of materials to take in light and not reflect it back
Transparent materials allow all light to pass through them
Transmission is the ability of light to pass through some materials
Opaque materials block light and reflect it
Translucent materials allow only some light to pass through
Some materials absorb light and change it to heat
Blackout curtains are opaque materials used to block light
Stained glass is a translucent material that partially allows light through
A mirror has a smooth, shiny surface that reflects light
A simple electric circuit has a load, switch, source, and wire
A closed circuit allows electricity to flow and makes a bulb light up
An open circuit prevents electricity from flowing so the bulb stays off
